summary: DungeonContext with brief section 19's fields and a signature folded over every one of them, so the same context always yields the same rooms and a different owner or tier never collides; plus the reward budget repeated farming draws down.

coordination.notes: building.rs: exactly one field appended at the END of BuildingInstance's field list (stored_value, serde(default)) plus its initialiser in place_building. Other lanes appending their own fields to the same tail merge with this. Everything else S9 owns lives in strategy/dungeon.rs, including the impl ExpeditionState block. No change to tick.rs, expedition.rs, save_migration.rs (the new field is nested inside ExpeditionState.buildings, so EXPECTED_CURRENT_KEYS is unaffected). Open on completion: (1) refilling a reward budget is blocked: needs decision -- stored_value only ever goes down here, and nothing raises it; place_building initialises it to zero, so every dungeon is empty until S13/S3 or a C card gives it a value. (2) Per-instance upgrade history is needs decision -- brief section 12's "upgrade history" is folded as the tier ladder read from the definition, because BuildingInstance stores a current tier and nothing about the road to it. (3) Every band threshold (CORRUPTION_BAND_*, HEAT_BAND_*, EPOCH_*) and every budget coefficient (ENCOUNTER_BUDGET_PER_TIER, HAZARD_BUDGET_PER_TIER, HAZARD_BUDGET_PER_CORRUPTION_BAND) is provisional needs decision; EPOCH_ENDGAME_DAY alone is derived, being S8's CONFRONTATION_DAY. (4) NOT_A_DUNGEON = "none" is the sentinel C10 authors into dungeon_relationship for a building that deliberately is not one; an empty field reads the same way. (5) Brief sections 12 and 19 list no party-relevant flag, so none was invented; A7's suppressed_site_rules does not exist yet and is not read. (6) Section 19's generated_seed, generated_room_ids and revision are generation outputs: DungeonContext::of returns them zero/empty, and they still fold, so a deliberate regeneration at a bumped revision is a different dungeon.
